title: Styles
description: The dance-floor styles the app teaches. Each move belongs to one. Shown in this order.

id.description: Stable short id. Moves and saved settings refer to it, so never change or reuse one that has shipped.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the style feels like.

bpm.description: Typical tempo range in beats per minute, and where the practice beat starts for this style.

default.description: Tempo the practice beat starts at.

music.description: Genres you'd hear this style danced to.

why.description: Optional: something about the style that isn't obvious and helps people get it.
